description.value: Smuggler's Cove is a cozy British-style neighbourhood pub in the Cadboro Bay area of Saanich, featuring a second-floor deck and 12 beers on draught. It serves global comfort fare including burgers, fish and chips, and entrees, with an adjacent liquor store on site. Touring cyclists will find a welcoming local atmosphere with online ordering and takeout options available.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 55m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the pub at 2581 Penrhyn St, Saanich (Cadboro Bay), matching OSM address. The site explicitly offers dine-in and takeout, lists a phone number absent from OSM, and OSM tags internet_access=no, confirming no Wi-Fi. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most amenities is found on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists (250) 477-2688 — added from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating neighbourhood pub confirmed open via website with dine-in and takeout. Useful stop for touring cyclists in Cadboro Bay.
